summary_markdown: The discussion focused on optimizing queries for device session concepts. Specifically, the use of `box_mac` as a filter was questioned. It was noted that using `company_num` and `session_start_hour` in filters would be acceptable alternatives. Regarding `box_mac`, it will remain for major clients but will be removed for facilities where more than one box is present on the same facility, primarily affecting J&J.
decisions: The use of `box_mac` as a filter will be restricted to major clients.
